faultLoc.explanation: This line is causing a NullPointerException because it does not check if 'str' or 'search' is null before calling the 'length()' method on them. If either 'str' or 'search' is null, this will throw an NPE.
This line is also potentially faulty because it does not check if 'search' is null before calling the 'length()' method on it. If 'search' is null, this will throw an NPE.
